slides.texte_overlay:
things smart people quietly
do on a sunday

they plan the week

they spend fifteen minutes writing down the three things that truly matter this week. a short, clear plan stops monday from feeling chaotic, rushed and heavy.

they rest on purpose

they take a proper slow morning with no alarm and no rush. smart people know that real rest is not wasted time, it's what makes the busy days possible.

they tidy one space

they reset one room or one desk before the week begins. starting monday in a calm, clean space makes it so much easier to think clearly and get going.

they learn for fun

they spend a few minutes learning something just for the joy of it: a myth, a planet, a painting. curiosity with no pressure is the very best way to start a fresh week.
slides.texte_sophia:
they learn for fun

they learn something just for fun, like a myth or a planet. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and 5 minutes on a sunday morning feels wonderful.

slides.texte_overlay:
they call someone they love

they ring a friend or a parent for a real conversation instead of just texting. a warm chat on a sunday makes the whole week ahead feel so much lighter.
